# package server

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-s7comm/server"
```

Package server is an S7 communication server for tests: it holds data blocks, inputs, outputs, markers, timers and counters in memory and answers classic S7 clients on ISO-on-TCP (RFC 1006, COTP TP0 through go-cotp).

It answers Setup Communication, Read Var and Write Var (S7ANY items, and DBREAD items as S7-400 CPUs take them, read only) with the item return codes, header errors and data transport sizes Siemens defines (STEP 7, Use of FETCH/WRITE; Wireshark's s7comm dissector names them the same way): 0x0A object does not exist, 0x05 invalid address, 0x06 data type not supported, 0x07 data type inconsistent, 0x03 accessing the object not allowed (read-only area, timers, counters); header error 0x8500 for an answer past the PDU and 0x8104 (service not implemented) for other jobs and user data. It accepts any rack, slot and TSAP. A PDU whose header cannot be read closes the connection. It is test infrastructure, not a PLC: there is no program, timers and counters do not run, and there is no access protection and no TLS. For every Setup Communication, Read Var and Write Var job recorded from real S7-300, S7-400 and S7-1200 CPUs (testdata/captures) it gives the CPU's answer byte for byte.

	srv, err := server.New(server.Config{})
	if err != nil { ... }
	_ = srv.RegisterDB(1, make([]byte, 64), server.AreaOptions{})
	_ = srv.RegisterArea(server.AreaMerkers, make([]byte, 32), server.AreaOptions{})
	err = srv.ListenAndServe(ctx, "127.0.0.1:1102")

## Constants

```go
const (
	MinPDUSize       = 240
	MaxPDUSize       = 4096
	DefaultPDUSize   = 480
	DefaultMaxConns  = 32
	DefaultHandshake = 5 * time.Second
)
```

Bounds of Config.MaxPDUSize. Setup Communication grants the smaller of the client's request and Config.MaxPDUSize.

```go
const MaxAreaSize = wire.MaxS7AnyByteOffset + 1
```

MaxAreaSize is the largest area: the S7ANY start address is 24 bits in bits.

## Types

### type Area

```go
type Area byte
```

Area is a memory area the server can hold.

```go
const (
	AreaInputs   Area = wire.AreaInputs  // I (process inputs)
	AreaOutputs  Area = wire.AreaOutputs // Q (process outputs)
	AreaMerkers  Area = wire.AreaMerkers // M (markers)
	AreaDB       Area = wire.AreaDB      // DB (data blocks, by number)
	AreaTimers   Area = wire.AreaTimer   // T (timers)
	AreaCounters Area = wire.AreaCounter // C (counters)
)
```

Areas a server can register. The other S7 areas are not held: a request for them is answered "object not available".

Timers and counters hold two bytes per element, the S5TIME or BCD count value as a CPU stores it: element n is at byte 2n of the area for the host-side Read and Write. Clients address them by element number with the TIMER or COUNTER transport size and read them as OCTET STRING; their writes are refused with 0x03, as a recorded CPU 315-2 PN/DP refuses them (testdata/captures).

### type AreaOptions

```go
type AreaOptions struct {
	// ReadOnly makes clients' writes fail with item code 0x03 (Siemens:
	// object access is not allowed), as a recorded S7-1200 answers a write
	// to a write-protected DB. Snap7-based servers send 0x0A for the same
	// case; see ERRORS.md.
	// The host-side Write still changes the area.
	ReadOnly bool
}
```

AreaOptions are the properties of a registered area.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	// MaxPDUSize is the largest PDU size Setup Communication grants,
	// MinPDUSize..MaxPDUSize. Zero means DefaultPDUSize.
	MaxPDUSize int
	// MaxConnections is the number of clients served at once; further
	// connections are closed on accept. Zero means DefaultMaxConns.
	MaxConnections int
	// HandshakeTimeout bounds the COTP connect of a new client. Zero means DefaultHandshake.
	HandshakeTimeout time.Duration
	// IdleTimeout closes a connection that sends no request for this long.
	// Zero means no limit.
	IdleTimeout time.Duration
	// Logger receives connection and request diagnostics. Nil discards them.
	Logger *slog.Logger
}
```

Config configures a Server. The zero value is valid.

### type Server

```go
type Server struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Server answers S7 communication on ISO-on-TCP (RFC 1006) from memory it holds: Setup Communication, Read Var and Write Var on the registered areas. Other jobs and user data (SZL, blocks, control) get header error 0x8104 (service not implemented). It accepts any rack, slot and TSAP.

#### func New

```go
func New(cfg Config) (*Server, error)
```

New returns a Server with no areas registered.

#### func (Server) Close

```go
func (s *Server) Close() error
```

Close stops all listeners and closes every connection, then waits for their goroutines. It is safe to call more than once.

#### func (Server) ListenAndServe

```go
func (s *Server) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context, address string) error
```

ListenAndServe listens on the TCP address and serves until ctx ends or Close.

#### func (Server) Read

```go
func (s *Server) Read(area Area, db, start, size int) ([]byte, error)
```

Read returns a copy of size bytes at start of an area. db is the DB number for AreaDB and ignored otherwise.


RegisterArea adds the inputs, outputs or markers area holding a copy of data.

#### func (Server) RegisterDB

```go
func (s *Server) RegisterDB(number int, data []byte, opts AreaOptions) error
```

RegisterDB adds data block number (1..65535) holding a copy of data.

#### func (Server) Serve

```go
func (s *Server) Serve(ctx context.Context, ln net.Listener) error
```

Serve accepts connections on ln until ctx ends or Close, and closes ln. It returns ErrServerClosed after Close and ctx.Err() when ctx ends; connections being served are closed in both cases.

#### func (Server) Write

```go
func (s *Server) Write(area Area, db, start int, data []byte) error
```

Write changes an area from the host side; ReadOnly does not apply.
